integrity: The finite face-poset matching, Hasse DAG and signed four-by-59 Morse boundary are reconstructed by the included standard-library script; no external data or earlier package needed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the 3-by-7 rectangular graph; no claim for all lengths or integral equivariance. The full text of the motivating 2026 preprint was inaccessible; comparable earlier all-length theorem was retracted. The result is supported by an exhaustive finite Morse calculation and same-model review; independent mathematical audit is not performed.
title: The matching complex of the three-by-seven grid is a wedge of 55 six-spheres
